actionAdapters.entry: business asmdef and source ownership; existing Nova.Event facade and lifecycle call sites
actionAdapters.when: 只读确认目标业务程序集、事件类型、发布者、订阅拥有者、注销点与既有 Event 门面，不修改 Framework

actionAdapters.entry: confirmed business EventData source, publisher, subscriber, lifecycle unsubscription and local Play probe
actionAdapters.when: 只修改已冻结的业务事件定义、发布/订阅链和探针，并保留 Clear、回池与生命周期边界

actionAdapters.entry: ReferencePool.Get<T> / Nova.Event.Subscribe<T> / Unsubscribe<T> / Fire / FireNow / EventData.Clone
actionAdapters.when: 在已冻结的主线程、时序与异步持有策略下取得事件、订阅、注销、发布或深拷贝；不执行任意 C#

actionAdapters.entry: Unity script refresh, compilation and Play Mode event timing inspection
actionAdapters.when: 等待编译后验证所选 Fire 或 FireNow 路径、handler 效果、注销与回池边界；不改 Scene、Prefab 或 Event 配置

allow: confirmed business EventData C# source in the frozen business assembly and namespace
confirmed business publisher and subscriber C# source
confirmed lifecycle unsubscription source owned by the frozen subscriber
confirmed local C# Play probe used to observe dispatch, lifecycle and pool boundaries
deny: EventComponent, EventManager, EventPool configuration or default handler
Nova.prefab, Prefab, Scene or handwritten Unity YAML
business asmdef, namespace, global event registrar or unrelated event subscriptions
manual ReferencePool.Put for an event dispatched through Nova.Event
unconfirmed event payload, publisher, subscriber owner, dispatch model, lifecycle or Play probe
Bundle or Player output, device installation, external service or unrelated business code

requiredFor: ambiguous project root, event type, source file, assembly, namespace, payload, Clear contract, publisher, subscriber owner, lifecycle, calling thread, dispatch model, asynchronous retention strategy or Play probe
create or replace a business event type, publisher, subscriber, public payload contract, lifecycle behavior or local Play probe
change Fire to FireNow, use FireNow from an asynchronous or unverified thread, change an existing subscription owner, global event pool configuration or default handler
delete, build Bundle or Player, install to device, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认唯一业务程序集、事件类型与载荷、Clear/深拷贝策略、发布点与线程、订阅拥有者与注销点、Fire 或 FireNow 语义、Play 探针和最小写入集；任一输入、线程或范围变化后旧确认失效。

evidence: 业务 asmdef/编译单元、命名空间、完整事件类型名、载荷和 Clear 约定的冻结记录
发布者、订阅拥有者、同一 handler 的成对 Subscribe/Unsubscribe 与异步持有策略的源码证据
Unity 编译无本次新增错误
Play Mode 中 Fire 的下一次 Event 更新分发证据，或 FireNow 的同步主线程分发证据；两者都在范围时分别具备
Play Mode 中 handler 效果、注销后不再接收，以及事件对象未跨 handler 生命周期持有的证据
